content.title: Group Landing | Carrier Arrival, Pioneer Crossing, Queue Release
content.summary: Bring a group carrier to a readable boundary, let one pioneer cross first and establish a viable landing point, then use that continued advance to release the follower queue. Finish from a wider or higher view that proves carrier, path, group flow, and destination together.

quick_start.input_format: group carrier and environmental boundary + pioneer-first crossing + forward release cue + ordered follower flow + high-view occupancy proof
quick_start.recommended_input: An original flood-response barge reaches a submerged orchard road at gray dawn. One adult medic in a sunflower-yellow dry suit crosses a stable pallet bridge first, plants a cyan route beacon, and signals. Three responders carry silver medical cases along the same path before a high view proves the complete barge-to-field-clinic transfer.
required_anchors: Establish one group carrier, one environmental boundary and one identifiable lead subject in the same opening geography.
Let the lead subject complete the first crossing before the follower group begins its release.
Release followers in one ordered flow while keeping the carrier and boundary traceable.
End from a wider or higher view that shows changed occupancy across carrier, path and destination.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Bring a group carrier to a readable boundary, let one pioneer cross first and establish a viable landing point, then use that continued advance to release the follower queue. Finish from a wider or higher view that proves carrier, path, group flow, and destination together.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Bring one group carrier to a clearly visible environmental boundary. Keep a lead subject identifiable as that subject performs the first complete crossing and establishes a viable direction beyond the boundary. Use the leader's continued advance as the cue for an ordered follower release, then widen or elevate the view until carrier, crossing path, leader and group destination are readable together. The reusable mechanism is carrier arrival, pioneer proof, queue release and spatial confirmation, not the source longship, warriors, weapons, shields, storm or historical identity.

invariants.rule: Establish one group carrier, one environmental boundary and one identifiable lead subject in the same opening geography.
invariants.purpose: Defines origin, obstacle and agent before movement.
invariants.ablation_failure: A close action opening cannot prove where the group came from or what must be crossed.

invariants.rule: Let the lead subject complete the first crossing before the follower group begins its release.
invariants.purpose: Makes the route proof causal and attributable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Simultaneous mass movement removes the pioneer function.

invariants.rule: Keep the lead subject moving beyond the boundary while the first follower enters the proven path.
invariants.purpose: Turns solo success into a release signal.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the leader stops or disappears, the queue lacks directional ownership.

invariants.rule: Release followers in one ordered flow while keeping the carrier and boundary traceable.
invariants.purpose: Makes group transfer legible instead of chaotic.
invariants.ablation_failure: Detached crowd inserts or reversed flow break the spatial handoff.

invariants.rule: End from a wider or higher view that shows changed occupancy across carrier, path and destination.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on a single hero pose cannot prove the group has transferred.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source Viking-like warriors, faces, armor, swords, round shields and group identity
the source dark longship, black sail, emblem, beach, storm clouds and lightning
the source exact leap, weapon raise, disembark order, shoreline angle and crane movement
the source gray-blue historical-war palette and any marks or heraldry
the source audio, battle vocalization, wave timing and creator post wording
